The '''''Avenger''''' was a [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Zarin]] served aboard the ''Avenger'' in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].
